# Vendored: read_aloud v0.3.3 (Rust TTS backend)

This directory contains the upstream `read-aloud` crate v0.3.3, vendored as the
native TTS backend for chatvv. It replaces the former hand-written Edge WebSocket
client (`src/tts/edge_tts.{h,cpp}`, removed).

## Provenance

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Upstream | https://github.com/naskopw/read_aloud |
| Version | v0.3.3 (crate `read-aloud` 0.3.3) |
| Download | https://static.crates.io/crates/read-aloud/read-aloud-0.3.3.crate |
| SHA-256 (crate tarball) | `05e6e182600d1a92ecfa1806c532cd990acb06908d68cf50bc4e89ab4a189b7b` |
| Upstream git commit | `2090dd33532263b39370a0a4bba7cb0c665f2032` (`.cargo_vcs_info.json`) |
| License | GPL-3.0-only, see `LICENSE` (compatible with this repository's GPL-3.0 `LICENSE`) |

The C ABI used by chatvv is implemented in `src/ffi.rs`
(`read_aloud_text_to_speech`, `read_aloud_speech_options_init`,
`read_aloud_status_string`, `read_aloud_last_error_message`). The C header is
generated by `build.rs` (cbindgen) into the cargo target directory as
`read_aloud.h`; `cmake/readaloud.cmake` stages it to
`${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/read_aloud/include/read_aloud.h`.

## Local patches (build configuration only, no upstream logic changes)

1. `Cargo.toml` / `Cargo.toml.orig`: `[lib] crate-type` changed from
   `["cdylib", "rlib"]` to `["cdylib", "staticlib", "rlib"]`.
   iOS requires a static library; chatvv also prefers static linking on
   Linux/Windows/macOS so only one shared object (`libchatvv_ffi`) has to be
   shipped. All three artifacts are produced by a single `cargo build`.
2. `Cargo.lock`: `openssl` 0.10.76 -> 0.10.82 and `openssl-sys` 0.9.112 ->
   0.9.118. The 2024-era lockfile only understood OpenSSL <= 3.x; the newer
   releases add OpenSSL 4.x support (Arch Linux ARM hosts already ship
   OpenSSL 4.1). OpenSSL 1.1/3.x remain supported, so CI images are unaffected.

3. `src/lib.rs` (protocol fix, 2026-10): Microsoft moved Edge Read Aloud from
   `wss://speech.platform.bing.com/consumer/...` to
   `wss://api.msedgeservices.com/tts/cognitiveservices/websocket/v1`. The old
   host now rejects the WebSocket handshake with HTTP 403, so every synthesis
   failed. The URL now sends the same client token as
   `Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key` (the new host refuses `TrustedClientToken`) and
   keeps the existing `Sec-MS-GEC` token/version and Edge User-Agent.
4. `src/voices.rs`: `zh_CN_XiaomengNeural` added to the generated `Voice` enum
   and its `From<Voice> for &str` mapping. The voice was retired from the
   online list in 2026-09; chatvv keeps it accepted and `Synthesize()` retries
   with the default voice when the service closes the socket (see
   `src/tts/synthesize.cpp`, `tts_voice_fallback`). The matching entry was also
   added to `src/tts/read_aloud_voice_table.inc`.

`build.rs`, `cbindgen.toml`, `tests/` and `tools/` are byte-identical to the
published crate; the files above contain only the patches listed here.

## What was intentionally omitted

- `.github/` (upstream CI) to avoid a nested workflow.
- `target/`, `venv/` and other build outputs (see upstream `.gitignore`).
- `Cargo.lock` is kept (reproducible `--locked` builds).
- `.cargo_vcs_info.json` is kept for provenance.

## chatvv additions (not upstream)

- `.gitignore` — upstream ignores `Cargo.lock`; chatvv keeps the pinned lockfile
  under version control so CI can build with `--locked`.
- `chatvv-gen-voice-table.py` — chatvv-owned generator that turns
  `src/voices.rs` + the cbindgen `read_aloud.h` into
  `src/tts/read_aloud_voice_table.inc` (the voice string -> `VOICE_*` enum map
  used by the C++ wrapper). Re-run it after updating the vendored version:

```sh
cargo build --release --manifest-path third_party/read_aloud/Cargo.toml
python3 third_party/read_aloud/chatvv-gen-voice-table.py \
  --voices third_party/read_aloud/src/voices.rs \
  --header third_party/read_aloud/target/release/read_aloud.h \
  --out src/tts/read_aloud_voice_table.inc
```

## Updating

Fetch the same crate tarball for a newer tag, replace the tree, re-apply the
`crate-type` + `Cargo.lock` patches above, then regenerate the voice table with
the command above and update `docs/read-aloud.md` / `third_party/README.md`.
